sources.entry: ZOT OCI Registry - A production-ready vendor-neutral OCI-native container image registry. (Demo, Source Code) Apache-2.0 Go/Docker

summary.one_liner: zot is a vendor-neutral, OCI-native container image registry that stores images in OCI image format and serves the distribution specification on the wire.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and mostly links out to external documentation, so detailed features cannot be confirmed from it. It describes zot as a production-ready, vendor-neutral OCI image registry. It states that images are stored in OCI image format and that the distribution specification is used on the wire. The README does not list further features, setup steps, or configuration options. The awesome-selfhosted listing places it under file transfer and object storage and file servers, with Go and Docker noted.
notable: Stores images in OCI image format
Implements the OCI distribution specification on the wire
caveats: README is nearly empty and defers all documentation to an external site, so setup and feature details are unverified here
No run or install instructions are given in the README
keywords: share container images with my team
